amlgym.benchmark_family: IPC learning tracks represented by AMLGym

predictive_sampling.state_ranking: sha256(confirmatory-state-rank-v1, domain, problem, semantic_state_fingerprint) after pilot exclusion
predictive_sampling.state_deduplication: exact canonical symbolic-state fingerprint before ranking
predictive_sampling.pilot_selector_replay: sha256 index ranking exactly matching inspected pilot: state|domain|problem|index
predictive_sampling.confirmatory_candidate_pool: all predictive states excluding every semantic duplicate of an actually selected pilot state

deploy_nonempty_if: candidate calibration risk is strictly lower than upstream calibration risk
candidate calibration false-allow count is not greater than upstream calibration false-allow count
deployment_gate.tie_policy: reject nonempty repair and use upstream decision

claim_boundary: Pilot outcomes motivated the frozen v4 deployment and split protocol. The historical pilot index-hash selector is replayed exactly, and every semantic duplicate of an actually inspected pilot state is removed before confirmatory selection. Confirmatory test labels are never used for repair fitting or deployment gating. The full matrix is reported regardless of improvement, tie, worsening, failure, or timeout; scientific performance is not a CI pass condition. DOVOD repairs applicability decisions only and does not rewrite learned effects.
